claim: the reported split-call shape reaches this seam as an unprovable fragment, and the shipped engine refuses it instead of guessing a boundary

source.shape: one ask_user_question call split across three function_call items; the per-item guard throws on the first fragment

measured.label: fragment-1 (the only bytes the failure message carries)

why_refusal_is_the_answer: the three fragments belong to one call; the adapter rejects each item separately and the failure text this side sees contains only the first fragment. Any boundary between fragments would be a guess, which this project forbids (P-0037’s rule: repair only when the proof is unique).
not_proven: the reporter’s OpenAI Responses route was not driven from this machine; their stable replay is theirs
the adapter-side per-item validation and the host default retry list are out-of-seam
a future adapter that forwards the joined text would change this case, and the recorder would then need a new stamp
